annotations.title: Show an AI crawler check card

description: Check one page for AI crawlers and AI search (the same check and limits as audit_url) and show the result as a visual card in apps that render one (ChatGPT, Claude): the score, which AI crawlers are let in or blocked, the costliest finding with its fix and how many findings are locked, by priority. Use it when the user wants to see a site's AI crawler access at a glance; use audit_url for a Markdown report.

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 60 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

url.description: Page to audit: a full URL or a bare domain such as example.com (https is assumed).
url.title: Url

name: show_ai_crawler_check

outputSchema.description:
structuredContent of show_ai_crawler_check: the preview (teaser.teaser_dict) or the full report dict
(Report.to_dict) plus what the card needs. The other keys of those dicts pass through.

access.description: One row per AI crawler: bot, cls, status, verdict.
access.title: Access

counts.description: Findings per priority, P1 to P3, of the whole report.
counts.title: Counts

full.description: True: every finding is in findings. False: a preview, the rest only by priority.
full.title: Full

lead.description: The costliest finding with its fixes, the one the preview opens.
lead.title: Lead

links.description: report: the page on aiseewhy.com; example: a sample full report.
links.title: Links

note.description: Why no new check ran (the site was checked before), or null.
note.title: Note

score.description: value 0-100 and visible: whether AI crawlers and AI search can read the page.
score.title: Score

tone.description: Score ring tone: ok, p2 or p1.
tone.title: Tone

outputSchema.title: CrawlerCheck

title: AI crawler check card
